name: ViewDefinition run scoping Test
title: ViewDefinition run scoping Test
description: Tests which server data $viewdefinition-run reads: patient and group compartments past one search page, both together, an empty group, _since with and without them, and instance-level runs.

operation.description: Stored view for the instance-level run.

test.name: patient covers more than one search page

operation.description: Run the Observation view for Patient 1, who has 60 Observations (the default search page is 50).

assert.description: All 60 of Patient 1's Observations, in id order, and no one else's.

operation.description: Run the Patient view for the Group of Patients 1 and 2.
Run the Observation view for the Group of Patients 1 and 2.

assert.description: Every Observation of Patients 1 and 2, none of Patient 3's.

test.name: patient and group together allow only what both allow

operation.description: Run for Patient 3 and the Group, which Patient 3 is not in.

assert.description: No rows: the two limits leave nobody.

operation.description: Run for Patient 1 and the Group, which Patient 1 is in.

test.name: an empty group gives no rows

operation.description: Run the Patient view for a Group with no members.

assert.description: No rows, rather than every Patient.

operation.description: Run for Patient 2 with _since in the past.
Run for Patient 2 with _since in the future.

test.name: _since applies to a Patient view limited by patient

operation.description: Run the Patient view for Patient 1 with _since in the past.
Run the Patient view for Patient 1 with _since in the future.
Run the Observation view over all server data with _since in the future.

test.name: the view can be the ViewDefinition in the URL

operation.description: Run the stored ViewDefinition at instance level for Patient 2.
Run at instance level and also send viewResource.
